name: Arao (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Arao city emblem in white: an outlined ring with a pointed stroke rising to the upper fly.
history: Municipal flag of Arao, a city in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 April 1996; the emblem dates from 1 April 1962.

features.role: Arao city emblem — an outlined ring with a pointed stroke rising to the upper fly
